insight.headline: Invalid Metafield Queries
insight.what_changed: The GraphQL Admin API now returns an error when a query filters by a metafield that isn't set up for filtering. This change is available in API version 2026-10. Previously, the API would silently return incorrect results.
insight.developer_impact: Developers should update their code to handle the new error response. They can do this by checking the error message and adjusting their query filters accordingly. This change affects all GraphQL Admin API queries that use metafield filters. Developers should review their code and test their queries to ensure they are handling the new error response correctly.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will see more accurate results from apps that use the GraphQL Admin API, as apps will no longer receive incorrect results due to invalid metafield queries.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the accuracy and reliability of the GraphQL Admin API, which is essential for building robust and reliable Shopify apps.
insight.code_example: query { products(metafield: { key: "invalid_key" }) { edges { node { title } } } }

recap.headline: Shopify updates enhance customer account management, order tax calculations, and POS printing

themes.title: Customer Account Management
themes.detail: The shopify-account component is now a Theme Store requirement, and Shopify Functions API version 2026-10 adds a createdAt field to the Customer object. This enables more efficient customer account management and automation.

themes.title: Order Management and Tax Calculations
themes.detail: Updating an order's shipping address now recalculates taxes, and the GraphQL Admin API returns errors for invalid metafield queries, improving the accuracy of order processing and data querying.

themes.title: Development Tools and POS Enhancements
themes.detail: Hydrogen and mini-oxygen updates improve local debugger connections, and POS UI extensions can now print directly to hardware receipt printers using the Printing API, enhancing developer experience and POS functionality.

Update your Shopify Functions to utilize the new createdAt field
Test and adapt to the new tax recalculation behavior for order updates
